source_backed_findings: Relationships are directional unless an explicit paired relationship is authored.
F009 defines fourteen distinct relationship dimensions rather than one relationship score.
F009 permits numeric, ordered-enum, band-only and validated-custom-scalar profiles; no universal relationship scale is source-authorized.
F009 defines seven independently revealable relationship layers and keeps graph/list/cache/AI projections nonauthoritative.
Social Gameplay presents Persuasion, Deception, Intimidation, Insight, Performance, Negotiation, Empathy, Command, Street Smarts and Investigation as social skills with example DCs.
Social Gameplay and Social status sources distinguish broad area/community social status from interpersonal social status.
Social Gameplay gives five Bond examples (Kindred, Blood, Rivalry, Romantic and Mentor) and source-specific Bond XP examples; these are examples, not universal PPIA-10 thresholds.
The retained social-status sources enumerate example status effects, including 20 artisan/craftsman/performer-specific examples; they do not define one mandatory global registry.
F010 separates objective truth, NPC belief, Player belief, lies/claims, rumor, knowledge, motive, secret, mood, intent, stance, relationship and faction standing.
F010 defines freeform, assisted and structured-challenge social modes and keeps Persuasion from becoming mind control.
Persistent Social Mode consequences are atomic Event-group proposals delegated to their owning domains rather than copied into Social Mode.
F016 keeps membership, rank, office, standing/reputation, influence, ownership, equipment and permission separate.
F016 standing and influence use profile-defined scales; its Allied/Neutral/Hostile and draft standing tracks are examples only when explicitly bound.
F016 requires plausible information-path evidence for standing changes and keeps influence separate from standing.
The F016 progression corpus contains seven converted organizations and 956 canonical progression records, but progression grants no automatic membership or authority.
The retained Factions.PDF provides eleven named organization/faction/government headings with uneven source detail, suitable for reference fixtures but not uniform schema inference.
Hidden relationship/faction/social state must be permission-filtered before topology, counts, search, export, realtime, notifications, diagnostics and AI context.
Graph/canvas position is presentation state; semantic list/table/nonvisual equivalents remain required.
explicit_source_gaps: No universal numeric relationship, standing/reputation or influence scale is source-defined.
No universal social difficulty/DC table is source-defined; retained DCs are examples/profile guidance.
No rule authorizes automatic reciprocal relationship mutation from a one-way edge.
No rule authorizes inferring faction membership, rank, office or permission from occupation, title, species, progression or capability.
The retained Factions.PDF does not provide a uniform field-complete faction schema for every named organization.
The relationship register contains only four source-explicit relationship facts; absent rows may not be synthesized.
The faction register contains zero stable faction references; implied civic/role labels may not be promoted to faction IDs.
The 209-row social-mechanic register does not provide 209 executable Actions; 196 wrappers remain unmatched and three exact-name cases are ambiguous.
The source does not define a universal mapping from every social-status example to one canonical Condition/status implementation.
The source does not define a complete autonomous faction turn, public-opinion simulation or geopolitical economy.
The source does not define AI authority to portray NPC truth, reveal secrets, decide outcomes or commit persistent consequences.
Overlap among source terms such as fear, loyalty, reputation, social status and interpersonal effects requires typed ownership rather than name-based merging.
